info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Guarantees Management API
info.description: The Bank Guarantees Management API enables financial institutions to facilitate the issuance of bank guarantees for their customers. This endpoint allows authorized users to submit new bank guarantee requests associated with specific customer profiles. Typical consumers include bank employees and financial advisors, who utilize this API to streamline the guarantee process, enhance customer service, and ensure compliance with banking regulations. By providing quick and efficient access to guarantee services, this API supports improved financial operations and customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Create a bank guarantee for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a bank guarantee associated with a particular customer identified by their unique ID. The request should include all necessary details regarding the bank guarantee being created.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new bank guarantee for the specified customer. It must include all required fields as defined in the schema.

201.description: Resource created successfully, representing the newly added bank guarantee.
